spawn.role: held-out u_ref limitation test; original LC objects retained

stop.application: Every controller-delivered inference at first72Hz poll, no wait for9Hz/FRESH; D750 unchanged
stop.geometric_goal_stop: Disabled only while option is enabled; goal radius/config unchanged and distance evaluation only
stop.terminal_result: Do not install its waypoint; do not declare on post-termination drained inference
stop.collision_precedence: Frozen collision/corridor stops retain priority at the same integration tick

outcomes.success: declared arrival AND distance<=0.5m AND collision==False

localization.odometry: Recorded72Hz cumulative XY path length at observation tick; delta between accepted inference inputs,first delta0

planner: Phase45 frozen B->R3 only; A/R2 disabled; ALL_UNSAFE uses identical OURS-DETOUR fallback
appearance: Original Phase38/43 appearance and Topomap; no Phase44 materials or regenerated maps

post_detour.primary: END of applied R3 through min(END+10s,run termination)
post_detour.truth: nearest Topomap XY node; evaluation only
post_detour.overlapping: Per-run/scope union of inference IDs; episode windows also saved
post_detour.missing: n0 and NA for no completed detour/no observations; active-at-termination counted

trigger_analysis.online: Depth-only component cell centers from exact field used by frozen B predicate; no oracle input
trigger_analysis.oracle: Report only:actual boxes spawned by trigger time; rotated XY box footprint
trigger_analysis.historical_missing: Only exact matching archived frame; never substitute or count missing as false
trigger_analysis.false_results: R3 disposition/installed/end reason and final run outcome; no causal attribution
